# Floralyn Nail Art Studio — Jetpur, Gujarat

> Private 1-on-1 custom gel nail art atelier in Jetpur, Gujarat, India. Specialising in freehand brushwork, natural nail care, botanical floral gel sets, and bespoke bridal nail keepsakes.

## Studio Overview
- **Brand:** Floralyn Nail Art Studio
- **Location:** Jetpur, Gujarat 360370, India (also welcoming clients from Navagadh, Gondal, Dhoraji, and Rajkot)
- **Booking Policy:** Strictly by appointment only — private 1-on-1 chair sessions with zero back-to-back rushing.
- **Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST (Closed Sundays)
- **Focus:** Natural nail health, sterilised steel cuticle tools, low-odour builder & soft gel systems, 100% freehand artistry (zero stickers or stamping plates).
- **Contact:** floralyyn7@gmail.com | Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/floralyn_nails_07
- **Booking URL:** https://floralyn-nails.vercel.app/#booking

## Service Menu & Pricing (INR)
- **Simple Manicure** (~45 min, from ₹300): Precision nail shaping, gentle cuticle care ritual, and classic high-shine polish finish.
- **Gel Nails** (~60 min, from ₹700): Natural-nail builder strength base with long-wearing chip-resistant solid colour, French, glaze, or soft ombre (lasts 2–4 weeks).
- **Custom Nail Art** (~90 min, from ₹1,200): Bespoke freehand brushwork sculpted around your mood board — botanical florals, tortoiseshell marble, cat-eye velvet, chrome foil, and sheer jelly layers.
- **Bridal & Occasions** (~2 hrs, from ₹2,000): Custom wedding, engagement, and festive sets crafted to complement your outfit palette and jewellery, including pre-session mood consultation.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Walk-ins:** By appointment only; book at least 24 hours ahead online.
- **Extensions:** Floralyn currently focuses on nourishing gel artistry over natural nails.
- **Reference Photos:** Clients can bring outfits, Pinterest inspo, or use the interactive Mood Customiser on the website before submitting their enquiry.
- **Payment:** Cash and UPI accepted in-studio.
